phone.changelog: Heart rate and oxygen can import timestamped readings shared by installed watch health apps. Displays the source app and original capture time; preserves existing history and archives. Install both 2.7.1 apps for sensor retries, app fallback and workout location recovery.

watch.changelog: Retries compatible heart rate and oxygen sensors when the preferred sensor does not deliver a usable sample. Shows accuracy-zero sensor feedback as unverified; checks shared health-app exports on failed capture. Adds original health-app opening, immediate export checks, passive workout locations and stalled GPS recovery. Imported readings retain their original app/time. Private app data and unavailable hardware remain explicitly unavailable.
